items.criterion: Sign-up creates one account, one workspace and one empty draft site in a single transaction and returns a session with the new site identifier.
items.judgment: Call the sign-up endpoint once and read the caller's own site list back.

items.criterion: A replayed sign-up on one address inside the idempotency window returns the first answer and leaves exactly one account row.
items.judgment: Submit the same address twice and count the account rows.

items.criterion: An uploaded picture is stored in the object store at the site's own prefix under the hash of its bytes.
items.judgment: Upload a picture and read the bucket for the key the response names.

items.criterion: An anonymous caller is refused the picture of a site nobody has published.
items.judgment: Upload to a draft site, then request the picture with no session.

items.criterion: The public address of a site nobody has published is answered as not found.
items.judgment: Request the public address of a draft site with no session.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous publishes of one site leave the site naming exactly one live revision.
items.judgment: Fire two publishes at one site and read the stored row.

items.criterion: A second owner is refused a read of a site in another workspace, and the stored row is unchanged.
items.judgment: Read another workspace's site as the second seeded owner.

items.criterion: A free name answers as available at the stated yearly price in minor units, in the stated currency.
items.judgment: Query availability for a name the seeded registry does not hold.

items.criterion: The home route carries the measured copy deck, band for band, in the stated order.
items.judgment: Read the home document and compare its band copy against the copy deck.

items.criterion: The ambient field behind the hero reads as a wash of coloured light rather than as visible circles.
items.judgment: Open the home route and look at the area behind the opening headline.
